messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — control-plane 5xx rate > 5% over 3m. Top error sources: org-lookup (502), auth (504), billing enrichment timeouts. Paging @maria nguyen (primary oncall) and @samir patel (control-plane lead).

maria nguyen: on it, running standard runbook checks: config push history, recent deploys, and health of auth/orglookup pods. will post findings.

samir patel: grabbing graphs now — datadog: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors?query=controlplane.*5xx (paste). Looking at pod-level p95s — auth latency spiking at ~2.2s causing gateway timeouts. org-lookup returning 502s from a subset of instances.

jen ortiz: I noticed a config roll that touched ORG_CACHE_TTL ~ 20m ago (deployed by config-service). Could be pulling more upstream calls.

maria nguyen: good catch. rolling back that config now (config-service revert).

ops-runner: automations: reverting config release id `cfg-2026-04-15-2` -> running `./releases/revert --id cfg-2026-04-15-2`

samir patel: running quick log tail on org-lookup:
```bash
kubectl -n control-plane logs deploy/org-lookup -c app --since=10m | grep -E "ERROR|timeout|502"
```
results: lots of upstream billing client timeouts followed by `500` responses from internal cache refresh path.

jen ortiz: possible amplification: org-lookup does a billing enrichment call per request if cache miss. if cache TTL was lowered, that could explain fanout to billing.

maria nguyen: mitigation: 1) flip orglookup to cache-only mode, 2) temporarily circuit-break billing enrichment, 3) add gateway rule to stop retries on 502s to reduce fanout. Doing 1 & 2 now.

samir patel: commands to apply:
```bash
# toggle feature flag in configstore
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://config.internal/redwood/flags -d '{"orglookup.cache_only": true}'

# disable enrichment job in config
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://config.internal/redwood/flags -d '{"billing.enrichment": "off"}'
```

maria nguyen: feature flags applied. orglookup now serving from cache only (confirmed via logs: "cache hit ratio increased").

ryan cole: applying gateway tweak to reduce retries: set retry_on_502 = false for controlplane route; will patch via envoy control plane.

ops-runner: envoy patch snippet applied:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: controlplane
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure"  # before
      # updated to remove 502 retries for internal calls
      retry_on: "connect-failure"
      num_retries: 1
```

samir patel: also scaling auth replicas to soak more traffic while upstream stabilizes: `kubectl scale deploy/auth --replicas=8 -n control-plane`

jen ortiz: monitoring customer-facing impact: initial synthetic checks showed ~3% of API requests returned 5xx (mainly session validation flows). No immediate data-plane loss for inference paths, but control-plane calls (auth/orglookup) for new sessions affected.

maria nguyen: posting a quick customer impact note to status page draft: "Some customers may see transient errors when starting sessions; retries are being suppressed to avoid cascade. Engineers are actively mitigating." Adding to incident timeline.

incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Mitigations in flight — config rollback, cache-only mode, gateway retry reduction, auth replica scale up. Continue monitoring for 10m. If 5xx > 1% after 10m escalate to eng-sre lead.

samir patel: after initial mitigations, 5xx down to ~1.1% (3m window). p95 auth latency reduced from 2.2s -> 0.9s. billing clients still showing intermittent 504s for a subset of pods.

jen ortiz: suggestion: temporarily disable the billing enrichment path entirely in the org-lookup code path (fast fail) to avoid any synchronous dependency. Could patch a config flag to make enrichment async.

maria nguyen: doing fast-fail flag flip now (`billing.enrichment = "async"`).

ops-runner: flag applied and verified. logs show fewer outbound billing calls.

samir patel: good — 5xx now ~0.47% over 5m, error budget for controlplane routes back within threshold.

maria nguyen: handoff plan: I'll continue 30m more to watch for regressions, then handoff to @jen ortiz (night oncall). Summary for handoff: reverted cfg-2026-04-15-2, orglookup cache-only, billing enrichment async/disabled, gateway retry reductions, auth scaled to 8 replicas. Customers: transient session start errors for ~30m window, now largely mitigated.

jen ortiz: thanks — will take oncall and keep monitoring dashboards + runbook checks. If any increase, escalate to eng-sre and paging list.

ryan cole: logging a post-incident TODO: add a rate-limiter in org-lookup for upstream enrichment calls, add a canary for config pushes that touch ORG_CACHE_TTL.

maria nguyen: adding incident notes to ops doc and raising a follow-up ticket: #OPS-1229 (postmortem + action items). Closing this thread for now unless we see a rise. :white_check_mark:
